title: The easiest way to make croissant! Why I didn't know this method before!

items: 1 tbsp dry yeast or instant yeast (8g)

steps.text: Mix the ingredients (water, sugar, yeast).
Leave for 5 to 10 minutes.
Mix the ingredients (milk, salt).
Mixing dough by hands adding flour and 5 tbsp soft butter.
Knead for 6 minutes by hand.
Let the dough rest at room temperature for 1 hour.
Transfer the dough to a well-floured surface.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and take one piece and form a ball.
Roll out the dough into a circle.
Transfer the one circle to a well-floured dish and grease with soft butter.
Put on top a circle of dough and grease with soft butter, then put on top a circle of dough again.
Chill in fridge for one hour.
Transfer the dough to a well-floured surface and roll out the dough into a large rectangle.
Trim the edges.
Slice the large rectangle into 6 triangles.
Cut a small slit at the wide end of the triangle, then tightly roll up.
Transfer to a baking sheet.
Let the dough rest at room temperature for 1 hour.
Grease with egg.
Bake at 190° (375°F) for 20-25 minutes.
